hints.tr: Saatlik seride bir günü seçmek: `load.loc["2024-03-15"]` o günün bütün saatlerini veriyor.
hints.en: Selecting one day in an hourly series: `load.loc["2024-03-15"]` gives every hour of that day.

hints.tr: `load.between_time("22:00", "06:00")` gece yarısını geçen aralığı da anlıyor.
hints.en: `load.between_time("22:00", "06:00")` understands a range that crosses midnight.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
import pandas as pd

load = pd.read_csv("energy_hourly.csv", index_col="timestamp", parse_dates=True)["load_mw"]

print(len(load.loc["2024-03-15"]))

day = load.between_time("08:00", "18:00").mean()
night = load.between_time("22:00", "06:00").mean()
print(round(float(day), 1), round(float(night), 1))
print(round(float(day / night), 2))

print(round(float(load.at_time("18:00").mean()), 1))
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
import pandas as pd

load = pd.read_csv("energy_hourly.csv", index_col="timestamp", parse_dates=True)["load_mw"]

print(len(load.loc["2024-03-15"]))

day = load.between_time("08:00", "18:00").mean()
night = load.between_time("22:00", "06:00").mean()
print(round(float(day), 1), round(float(night), 1))
print(round(float(day / night), 2))

print(round(float(load.at_time("18:00").mean()), 1))
```
